messages.author: d0591fb2a98d1e44
messages.subject: Rstan 2.7 won't work on my computer
parts:
Hi,

I just updated RStan to version 2.7 and it is no longer working. When I try to compile code, I get this response:

Error in compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose) :
  Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created! clang++: not found
make: *** [file1c84eb8232c.o] Error 127
Warning message:
running command 'make -f "C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-31~1.0/etc/i386/Makeconf" -f "C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-31~1.0/share/make/winshlib.mk" -f "C:\Users\daniel\Documents/.R/Makevars"
SHLIB_LDFLAGS='$(SHLIB_CXXLDFLAGS)' SHLIB_LD='$(SHLIB_CXXLD)' SHLIB="file1c84eb8232c.dll" OBJECTS="file1c84eb8232c.o"' had status 2
In addition: Warning message:
running command 'C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-31~1.0/bin/i386/R CMD SHLIB file1c84eb8232c.cpp 2> file1c84eb8232c.cpp.err.txt' had status 1



I know that Rstan installed properly and that gcc and Rtools are installed correctly. How do I fix this?

Ben

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Rstan 2.7 won't work on my computer
parts:
On Friday, September 18, 2015 at 9:32:46 AM UTC-4, Daniel Berman wrote:
So it's as simple as going into the file Makevars and change CC=clang++ to CC=g++?

I'm currently on a friend's computer that is running Rstan and I looked at their Makevars file and there's nothing that says "CC=".

Also, in the file directory, is it a problem that some of the separators are now forward slashes?

The separators are probably fine, but calling a compiler that is not installed is not. It could have picked up CC=clang++ from a system-wide Makevars file or something. In any event, putting CC=g++ into ~/.R/Makevars will work if the machine has g++ installed.

Ben

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Rstan 2.7 won't work on my computer
parts:
On Friday, September 18, 2015 at 4:46:05 PM UTC-4, Daniel Berman wrote:
C:/Users/daniel/Documents/R/win-library/3.2/rstan/include/rstan/io/rlist_ref_var_context_factory.hpp:4:63: fatal error: stan/interface/var_context_factory/dump_factory.hpp: No such file or directory

That is likely due to a mismatch between StanHeaders and rstan. Either downgrade StanHeaders with

devtools::install_url("https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/StanHeaders/StanHeaders_2.7.0.tar.gz")

or upgrade rstan with

install.packages(c("rstudioapi", "ggplot2", "gridExtra"))
devtools::install_github("stan-dev/rstan", subdir = "rstan/rstan", ref = "develop")

Ben
